tools.name: read_crash_dump
tools.description: Return registers, call stack, execution pointer and fault metadata for a crashed worker.

tools.name: inject_hotpatch
tools.description: Validate and apply a bounded hot-patch to a crashed worker's faulting key only, then run post_reanimation_verify.

tools.name: verify_process_health
tools.description: Check PID continuity and heap consistency of a worker.

tools.name: inspect_memory_registers
tools.description: Return the register file, execution pointer, call-stack offsets and shared-memory heap frame of the worker's latest crash (or the current heap frame if none).
